slides.notes:
Landslide Sentinel v0.1 demonstrates one local cell retaining responsibility as observations, connectivity, reasoning roles and monitoring requirements change. The demonstrated physical domain is synthetic. The implementation uses real common C/D/E/Work/Root boundaries, real Gemini transport in a separately identified lane and historical real Environment Agency acquisition. Siren, report and local acquisition effects are admitted local mocks. The source and evidence landing is committed at 2f328be634247be11bc18a3b22a919f393d6ed1d. The radiolarian cover is conceptual domain artwork, not a sensor image or a scientific model. This presentation explains the scoped accepted demonstration, including preserved failures and evidence limitations.

slides.notes:
Research-informed scenarios. Source-bound execution evidence. Published operational challenges informed the scenario design. Radiolaria demonstrates selected software responses on controlled observations and mock effects; the cited researchers and institutions are not presented as project endorsers.

The chain is published problem → our software criterion → observed Sentinel behavior → exact execution source. R01–R12 establish external context; S and C identify recorded scenarios and contrasts; D01–D07 locate internal evidence. The translation into requirements is our engineering judgment, not a request attributed to the cited authors. Human direction, prepared AI assistants, Codex, domain adapters and the existing kernel all contributed. This is not automatic compilation of articles by BSEP. Specialists can inspect and challenge the mapping; a specialist-led revision cycle remains a future possibility, not an experiment already conducted.

Published source context:
R04: A Rainfall-Driven Virtual Sensors Model to preserve Landslide Early-Warning Capabilities under Monitoring Systems Failures — https://meetingorganizer.copernicus.org/EGU26/EGU26-10345.html
R07: Rainfall — https://www.api.gov.uk/ea/rainfall/
R10: A debris-flow alarm system for the Alpine Illgraben catchment: design and performance — https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11069-008-9303-x

Recorded Sentinel results:
C03: controlled primary/reserve loss gives LIMITED then INSUFFICIENT. C02: a new receipt does not refresh an old observation; LS2R2 adds coherent hourly interval requirements. C07/S5: measured recovery and separate native OFF, with later current-age/dependency corrections. These are recorded software outcomes, not findings claimed by the research sources.

Approximately 12 hours of Sentinel implementation on the existing kernel — owner-reported elapsed time. The owner’s estimate covers implementation and checks reaching accepted commit/push. Earlier kernel/domain development is excluded; the complete duration and cost of prior research and specification are not established. Presentation preparation followed implementation and was interrupted by tool limits. This is neither an independently timed benchmark nor a comparison against another stack, a model-call duration, an alarm-response measurement or total research-and-development time.

S0–S5 and C01–C10 span controlled, live and later correction lanes. They are not a newly executed aggregate test suite. Earlier inconclusive C01 pairs remain history beside the later valid live pair. The real cloud provider’s provenance remains visible; a physical local SLM was not installed. A model-free local branch is distinct from cloud emulation of a local analyst role. The independent safe-derived pin covers only enumerated LS2R2 package fields, not this research insert, the whole history or physical truth. No domain, provider, sensor or D/E execution was performed for this update.

slides.title: The local monitoring task
slides.lead: Observe, investigate, act locally, and explain what happened.
body: Changes in rainfall alter the next monitoring interval.
Fresh local evidence can justify a bounded signal while optional reasoning is still pending.
Recovery requires new measurements and a separate OFF decision.
slides.takeaway: Observe, investigate, act locally, and explain what happened.
slides.notes:
The task is not to have a chatbot announce a landslide. It is to keep a bounded local monitoring process coherent across changed evidence and optional dependencies. A synthetic slope supplies rainfall, displacement and an independent reserve channel. The site coordinates a finite catalogue of diagnostic operations and monitoring actions. It can ask an analyst which investigation would resolve the present uncertainty, but that response does not set thresholds, invoke an arbitrary sensor, modify the Host or authorize a signal. The chronological S0-S5 story exercises configuration, changed rainfall, roles, outage and signal, queued report delivery, measured recovery and local semantic memory. Separate latest live experiments establish real semantic producer-to-consumer relationships that the controlled whole story does not claim to demonstrate.

slides.title:
Replaceable intelligence
and local authority
slides.lead: The model is a contributor inside the cell.
body: Reasoning proposes a finite investigation.
The runtime binds sources, requirements and actual work.
Root remains the sole final authority; Host and Firewall enforce effects.
slides.takeaway: The model is a contributor inside the cell.
slides.notes:
The architecture separates a semantic role from the physical engine that supplies its contribution. A local algorithm, a future local SLM or a cloud model can fill a permitted role with truthful provenance. The model still has multiple useful choices and can return evidence gaps; no valid response is retried merely to obtain a preferred enum.

slides.lead: The runtime preserves insufficiency instead of inventing confidence.
body: Freshness uses measurement time; receipt time cannot renew an event.
Primary missing: LIMITED. Primary and reserve missing: INSUFFICIENT.
Independent lineage, order, units and explicit intervals are checked.

slides.title: OFF needs its own evidence
slides.lead: Three fresh pairs must cover the recovery interval.
slides.takeaway: Three fresh pairs must cover the recovery interval.
slides.notes:
The finite synthetic incident policy requires both displacement and reserve below or equal to 1000 micrometres, at least three new independent pairs, measured coverage of at least 30 seconds on each channel and no gap above 15 seconds. Current policy controls admissible local age. In LS2R2, a policy allowing age two seconds actually rejects five-second-old data; fresh witnesses can then establish valid recovery. Tests cover boundary values two, ten and twelve. Witnesses from changed calibration, lineage, units, statistic or relevant policy cannot be combined with earlier coverage: old witness history is retained as revoked evidence. Receipt timing and repeated old IDs cannot create a recovery interval. Even clearance remains a candidate condition until an independent current Root decision and native OFF complete.

slides.title: A report is immutable. Delivery is a state.
slides.lead: No acknowledgement means UNKNOWN, not success.
slides.takeaway: No acknowledgement means UNKNOWN, not success.
slides.notes:
The local mock outbox creates an immutable report payload, message identity and payload digest. Delivery attempts preserve those exact bytes, and the receiver acknowledgement must match the same identity and hash. The retained story records QUEUED, ATTEMPTED and RECEIVED. Negative controls cover a missing acknowledgement, changed payload, receipt misuse and expired action packets. A receipt is evidence of a prior bounded action; it is not authority to send again. This demonstrates a local source-bound report protocol and exact acknowledgement semantics. It does not claim distributed exactly-once delivery over arbitrary networks or that a public emergency authority received an alert. Network recovery does not clear the incident; recovery/OFF is a separate local path.

slides.title: Memory and current eligibility
slides.lead: LocalDRS does not resurrect an old permission.
body: Cold lookup, reviewed write, fresh query and bounded descent are separate steps.
Current Root, policy, calibration and dependency scope govern reuse.
Informational reuse yields new Work; it does not reopen an action packet.
slides.takeaway: LocalDRS does not resurrect an old permission.
slides.notes:
The runtime uses actual LocalDRS semantic records, queries, resolution and descent. A semantic recipe or incident summary can be written after appropriate local review. Warm selection evaluates current query scope, root identity, dependency fingerprint and time, and requires fresh Root review before informational descent. Policy or calibration changes make stale content ineligible; old data remains history instead of becoming the current plan. The latest fresh LOCAL_ALGORITHMS_ONLY continuation records one search, one descent, two local Work operations and zero model transports, with a fresh local intake. This is different from CAPTURED_REEXECUTION, which explicitly consumes a saved semantic response through current consumers and retains original provenance. Neither operation is an executable permission cache.

slides.lead: Time support and physical meaning are different questions.

slides.notes:
The current temporal investigation explicitly tests scenario-second ordering start <= end <= received <= evaluation; hourly accumulation requires a 3600-second interval, unit mm_x1000, statistic accumulation_1h and an adequate record. An old endpoint remains historical; a point labelled as an hour is incompatible. Missing interval support is named rather than invented. Spatial applicability separately compares declared synthetic site identities and always preserves the absence of a verified physical mapping. The real live environmental selection in LS2R2 performed the spatial investigation, not a live temporal choice: temporal fixes are established by targeted current consumer checks. A bounded SUPPORTED_FOR_DECLARED_USE result can coexist with UNRESOLVED_NO_VERIFIED_MAPPING, because those are different claims.
